load_bart_pretrained_model: load a pretrained BART model from HuggingFace hub using from_pretrained with model name
run_bart_forward_pass: run a forward pass through BARTModel with source tokens and previous output tokens
register_bart_classification_head: register a new classification head on BARTModel for sentence-level classification tasks
build_bart_large_architecture: build a BART large model architecture with 1024 embed dim and 12 encoder layers
review_bart_classification_head: review the BARTClassificationHead module for sentence-level classification with dropout and activation
